environment.description: Kubernetes 1.27 cluster running migration jobs as privileged containers with hostPath volume mounts. The migration pod spec uses `securityContext.privileged: true` and mounts the host filesystem at /host. Container runs as root (UID 0). No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. The MIGRATION_DIR environment variable is set to '/host/etc' allowing zip slip traversal to write arbitrary files to the host node filesystem (e.g., overwriting /etc/crontab, /etc/shadow, or injecting into /etc/kubernetes/manifests for static pod execution).
